name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2026-04-20, at wavelengths from 1.16 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
